note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper %TEMP%\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Budget, Requests and Gateway run hidden on 5313/5312/5311; their log files are %TEMP%\mgnet\ep11-<service>.log and are shown with Get-Content/Select-String in the scenes. Screens depend on each other in order (calls, down, recovery, lost-answer): record them in one queue run.

screens.name: gateway-calls
commands: $gw = 'http://localhost:5311'; function Req($dept, $amount, $title) { Invoke-WebRequest "$gw/api/requests" -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Body (@{ title=$title; departmentCode=$dept; amount=$amount; requestedBy='alex.demo@contoso.com' } | ConvertTo-Json) }

Measure-Command { $b = Req IT 9000 'Laptops for the lab' }
